comment: cfgfiles.c parse_conf_buf() and config_erradd(). The first .nethackrc line is a 1150-byte comment, so fgets() fills the 1024-byte buffer with no newline and parse_conf_buf() calls config_error_add("Line too long, skipping") before config_error_nextline() has counted any line. The rc frame (not secure) still has line_num 0, so config_erradd() prints an empty original line and omits the 'Line N:' prefix (cfgfiles.c:1582-1585). The rest of the long line is discarded and the options on later lines apply. Return dismisses the error, Return dismisses the welcome --More--, then the Archeologist searches. Seed, clock, character and inputs were chosen independently of every recorded session.
